name: Reimbursement of the MS-CIT Course
benefit: - Reimbursement of the MS-CIT (Maharashtra State Certificate in Information Technology) course fees for up to two children of registered construction workers.
_eligibility_text: 1. The children's parents/guardians should be registered construction workers. 1. The construction worker should be registered under the MBOCWW. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a government-recognized MS-CIT course.
